reasons: Evidence-conditioned pass-1 region references were emitted as the full display marker suffix (for example bare region_id plus ' page=2'), while the guard required the bare source region ID; valid questions were therefore rejected as UNKNOWN_REGION_ID.
Several long generation outputs reached malformed/truncated JSON before semantic guarding.
The source-aware control was not an exact reproduction of Wave 7A because its source-context marker/prompt formatting changed to carry region IDs, causing widespread schema failures.
authorized_fix_boundary: Replace long source region IDs in the candidate prompt with short deterministic aliases and map aliases back to selected regions.
Restore the exact Wave-7A source-aware control prompt/context/guard implementation.
Increase candidate JSON output headroom only enough to prevent truncation while keeping intent-count and scientific gates unchanged.
Do not change retrieval, fusion budget, model family/revision, anti-leak teacher audit, promotion thresholds, page routing, or Wave 7B boundary.
